Loci"; image 200 = prose-style entries (Spudich names visible; possibly deaths); image 260 = tabular again; image 330 = a certification leaf with stamp (a book boundary). If Vid was born 8 Jan 1828 (Karen), his baptism predates this volume (births start 1832); the useful targets are his MARRIAGE(S) 1832-1857 (he may have had a first wife, so the four siblings could be half-siblings) and his death if before 1858. Section boundaries not yet mapped. MARRIAGE-SECTION MAP 17 Oct 2026 (second session, still NOT a nil): the volume's sections are not in the order the title lists. Marriages (Vjenčani, tabular Latin, columns end 'Character Copulantis', ~8-10 entries per spread) run through roughly images 450-510: image 450 ~1835, 480 = Nov 1843, 490 = 1849, 491-494 = 1851, 500 = Jan 1854 (priest Ladislaus Jagodić as officiant throughout). Approx 1850 marriages start at image ~490; 1857 probably ends before ~515 (end not pinned). Images actually looked at: 490, 491, 492, 493, 494 (1849-1851 marriages) - handwriting too blurry in the 900x650 browser viewer to read surnames reliably; no Spudić/Polović bride or groom was positively read, but that is NOT a nil. ONLINE TREES 17 Oct 2026 (unsourced, leads only): MyHeritage/FamilySearch Family Tree put Vid b.8 Jan 1828 Leskovac Barilovićki as son of Johannes 'Janko' Spudić (c.1801, d. before 1851) & Ana Pavletić, husband of Jelena Aršulić; Curlovic tree says he d. '1869?', which cannot be the father of a man born c.1889-91, so the 1828 Vid is at most a grandfather/uncle line. No tree found naming a Vid or Stephen as Janko's father. NEW LEAD 17 Oct 2026: FamilySearch Family Tree has Vid Spudić b.15 Nov 1846 Leskovac (LZJV-W2L), son of Ivan Spudić & Ana Maglić, m. 27 Nov 1867 Dorotea Polović b.4 Jun 1846 Novaki (LZJV-4SD), daughter of Josip Polović & Barbara Jurčević. Both births fall inside the 1832-1857 online volume (births section), and the Polović parents' marriage of 26 Nov 1832 is in the marriage section. Test: find Vid's baptism (15 Nov 1846) and Dorotea's (4 Jun 1846); the entries give fathers' names and house numbers (look for house 10). Tree has no sources and no children. REGISTER CONFIRMATION 17 Oct 2026: read Vid's baptism (image 81 left page, mid-Nov 1846: Vitus, son of Joannes Spudich of Leskovac N° 16 and Anna née Maglich) and Dorotea's (image 78 right page, entry 21, 4 Jun 1846: daughter of Josephus Polovich of Novaki and Barbara née Jurcevich). Open check: Vid's parents lived at N° 16 in 1846, Janko was born at house 10 in 1891; a move or a house split is possible. Next: read the marriage section for Josip Polović and Barbara Jurčević (26 Nov 1832, near the start of the marriage section, c. images 440-450) and the births of Dorotea's siblings (Juraj 1836, Jelena 1838) and Vid's siblings (Petar 1830, Ana 1832, Jelena 1842, Katarina 1844) for any note of a Dora/Dorotea link. 17 Oct 2026 later: read the 1832 marriage page (image 464): no Nov 1832 entry and no Josip Polović / Barbara Jurčević; last 1832 entry is 26 Sept (Thomas Gojak, widower, with Barbara, widow of Georgius Polovich). The tree's 26 Nov 1832 marriage date is unsupported. Marriage book II starts at image 463 (cover 462), not 450. Next: read 1833-1836 marriages (images 465-470) for Josip Polović and Barbara, since Juraj Polović was born 1836. CORRECTION 17 Oct 2026 (late): the Josip Polović / Barbara marriage of 26 Nov 1832 IS in the register (image 465, left page; see searched.json). Earlier note saying it was absent is wrong. So Dorotea's parentage is now confirmed by two register entries (marriage 1832, baptism 1846). Marriage book II 1832-35 read (images 464-467); 1836-1857 not yet read. UPDATE 17 Oct 2026 (second pass): the 2 Mar 1851 marriage of Vid Spudić (groom 'sin pokojnoga Janka Spudića', Leskovac Nº 3(?)) to Jele (d. of Mika Ar[šulić?]) is on image 492, left page, last entry (see sources/leskovac-marriage-book-ii-notes.md).
